2009 third team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference]] }} '''James Johnson''' (born [[February 20]], [[1987]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] player. He was the starting [[power forward]] for the [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Demon Deacons]] of [[Wake Forest University]] from 2007-2009. Johnson declared his eligibility for the [[2009 NBA Draft]] following his sophomore year. Johnson is listed as 6 ft 9 in (2.06 m) and 245 lb (111 kg).[http://wakeforestsports.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/johnson_james00.html James Johnson Wake Forest profile]. He is of [[African-American]] and [[Samoan]] heritage.http://www.samoanewsonline.com/viewstory.php?storyid=2431&edition=1245664800&newssection=Custom1 ==Collegiate career== Johnson signed with [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest]] out of [[Cheyenne East High School]] and had an instant impact, garnering third team All-ACC honors as a freshman and finishing second in the 2008 ACC Rookie of the Year balloting. He led the Demon Deacons in scoring and rebounding as a freshman. As a sophomore, Johnson again led the team in rebounding, leading the team to a 24-5 record and a #1 ranking during the [[2008–09 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2008-09 season]]. He was again named third team All-ACC.
